issue.title: bob-plugins reading board: show a vN chip for reread families

task_type_fields.proposal: Show a reading-number chip on the bob-plugins reading board for reread families: `vN` for N >= 2, and `v1` on a family root that has later readings, matching `bob ref list`/`show`. The data comes from bob: `bob ref list -f json` rows carry `reading` (null outside a family) and `earlier`; `bob ref show -f json` adds `later` (docs/ref.md JSON section; family phase commit 16f86b7d of bob-cli-c9). Do not infer families from `__vN` stems (a natural `protocol__v2` is reading 1 with no family). Proposed by bob-cli-c9.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 4) and listed as out of scope in plan:202610/ref_create_force_recapture.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-c9 is a bob-cli epic whose plan explicitly lists client chips in bob-plugins as out of scope (proposed follow-ups); the work lives in the bob-plugins linked repo and deploys via bob plugins sync.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-c9.6 note 4; bob now reports reading numbers for reread families but the reading board does not render them.

payload.description: Same reading-number chip for reread families on the other client; keep wording and v1/vN rules consistent
